description: This Java source file defines a class {@link MongoQueryBuilder} that implements the {@link QueryBuilder} interface. It provides methods to build, configure, and produce a MongoDB-specific query object for searching or counting documents based on criteria, sort options, limits, and skips.

classes.name: MongoQueryBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing MongoDB queries with criteria, sorting, limits, and skip values, ensuring thread safety is not guaranteed.

methods.name: limited
methods.description: Creates a builder instance for a limited query with specified max page size and default page size.

methods.name: unlimited
methods.description: Creates a builder instance for an unlimited query (count).

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sets the sorting options for the query, ensuring sort includes ID field as needed.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of documents to return, with validation.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Sets the size limit for the query, equivalent to limit().

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Sets the number of documents to skip in the result set.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a {@link Query} object based on current configuration.
